gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
It was a mistake not to write the telephone number down.
gaps.sentence: I should ___ writing down the telephone number.
gaps.hint: make a point of doing = be sure to do
gaps.explanation: Regret about an omitted action: 'should have made a point of writing it down'.

gaps.lead: He spoke so quietly that the jury couldn't hear him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for the jury to hear him.
gaps.explanation: so quietly that nobody could hear = too quietly (for anybody) to hear.
